title: Relay
description: packages.relay: the connection of the installation to the hub.

api.title: Hub API
api.description: Where the server reaches the hub's API, the internal port: http://127.0.0.1:8001.

client.title: Client path
client.description: Where the browser reaches the hub, on the same host as the page.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off: the connection stays configured, but nothing is published and no browser connects.

plainTopics.title: Plain topics
plainTopics.description: Readable channel names, for DEV. Off: names hashed with the secret, so a browser only learns the channels of what it was shown.

prefix.title: Topic prefix
prefix.description: The project's part of every channel name. Empty: the project namespace, plus the stage unless LIVE, so STAGING and LIVE on one hub never hear each other.

secret.title: Token secret
secret.description: The hub's client.token.hmac_secret_key: signs the tokens of the browsers and hides the channel names.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The hub's http_api.key: lets the server publish to the hub.
